raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (378 rows, ingested 2026-01-19) is the only batch with source_tz='UTC'; all earlier batches are America/Chicago local time. The silver step ignores source_tz, so UTC timestamps such as 12:03 UTC (06:03 CST) are treated as local time. That shifts late-evening Chicago transactions from 2026-01-18 onto 2026-01-19 00:00-06:00. The fix converts UTC-tagged rows to America/Chicago local time before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s"}}
